reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading verified: processBlock (line 896) hardcodes Opt.none(DataColumnSidecars) instead of passing entry.columns to storeBlock, discarding Engine API-sourced columns. Spec deviation confirmed: 01e property PROP-6a4369e9-post-003 in outputs/01e_PARTIAL_W2B3_1771748669.json requires 'imported columns must behave as if received via gossip' (assertion: forall col from EL: imported(col) => treated_as_gossip(col) == true). Spec diagram SG-010 INV-004 explicitly states: 'Imported data columns MUST behave as if received via gossip'. Code deviates by skipping gossip validation (validateDataColumnSidecar) that includes KZG proof verification and inclusion proof checks. Severity calibrated: Nimbus deployment share <5% per client diversity data caps maximum impact at Medium (not High). Attack requires compromised/buggy local EL to serve malformed columns via engine_getBlobsV2. Engine API is JWT-authenticated (semi-trusted boundary per BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE trust_assumptions), so exploitability is conditional on local EL compromise, reducing from High to Medium.
